findings.detail: The concentration-sized fair value is a schedule subtotal for affiliate investments, not an individual portfolio position.

rationale: The filing anchors total investments at fair value to 2,631,138 thousand in both the balance sheet and schedule total. The localized line driving the concentration is the source schedule subtotal 'Subtotal Affiliate Investments (15.6%)*' with fair value 274,834 thousand; it is a roll-up below individual affiliate rows, not a position. The nearby individual affiliate holding Rocade Holdings LLC is disclosed separately at 120,646 thousand and 6.9% of net assets, so treating the affiliate subtotal as a position is a real subtotal leak.
